# `network/realm/branches/RealmBranch.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/branches/RealmBranch.js`

RealmBranchV1 identity, ownership, signed-head chains, and branch DAGs.

## Classes

### `class RealmBranchDAG`

Verified in-memory projection of branch descriptors and RealmBranchRefV1 head chains. Persistence is delegated to BranchStorage.js.

## Functions

### `async createRealmBranch(input, signer)`

Create a stable RealmBranchV1. The label is intentionally excluded from the identity derivation, so renaming or alias changes cannot change branch IDs.

### `async verifyRealmBranch(branch, options = {})`

Verify branch identity, controller signature, and optional owner authority.
